extraction.Name: Robert McLean
extraction.Refused/Protested: I told Peter Farmer, one of My Indian neighbors that I did not want it. I did not expect to get this patent and did not want it but did not think it would do any good to send it back.
extraction.Recorded patent: It was sent to me by mail in 1920.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I thought the taxes would "eat up the land" so I sold it.
extraction.NOTES: Received $1500.00 and a Ford touring car (valued at $700.00, new) for the land. Deed of record shows price as $2400.00; McLean states he received only what he described. Did not remember signing receipt for patent. Wife and one child depend on him for support. Notary: J.S.W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32. Sworn May 15, 1929.
